senses.gloss: to arrange, stipulate, esp. to negotiate a marriage (by sending an agent to settle affairs).
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 13a:6">Kidd. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>התם בדש׳</he> in that case it means that he had been negotiating (when he finally betrothed her with a stolen object); <he>ומנא תימרא … בין ש׳ ודלא ש׳</he> and how will you prove that it makes a difference whether a betrothal was preceded by negotiations or not?
